remarks: Move right in to this newly-fully-updated-in-2025 end-unit townhouse offering a fresh, stylish interior and an exceptional location. A brand-NEW kitchen anchors the open-concept main level, creating an inviting flow for everyday living and entertaining. The home features 2 1/2 NEW updated baths, all-NEW HVAC systems and NEW hot water heater, new paint throughout, and two fireplaces that add warmth and character. As an end unit, the home enjoys added privacy: step outside to a pretty, private patio overlooking mature trees and greenery, a peaceful setting for morning coffee, outdoor dining or simply relaxing. $7,000 investment made in new Hunter Douglas blinds throughout. Westport's train station is just a short walk away, along with the restaurants, cafes and the vibrant atmosphere of Westport's Saugatuck neighborhood. The property has a Westport address while enjoying Norwalk amenities. Beautifully updated, exceptionally convenient and ready to enjoy, this is easy living at its best.
